name: Avinor Flysikring AS (Avinor Air Navigation Services)
notes: Renamed from placeholder no-avinor. om.avinor.no (Avinor's corporate site) has a page 'Avinor Air Navigation Services' and publishes the annual reports of Avinor Flysikring AS (e.g. avinor-flysikring-as-annual-report-2025.pdf); that body provides Norway's air navigation services (it states Norway is responsible for ATS in Bodo Oceanic FIR), as a subsidiary of the Avinor group. It has no separate logo: the only logo is the group Avinor logo (aria-label 'Avinor logo'), served as a white SVG (www.avinor.no / om.avinor.no /globalassets/logo.svg, tier 2, website-served) for dark site headers. The Profile Manual page (om.avinor.no/en/about-us/profile-manual/) says brand manual, signage manual, font and logo files are available only by request to Avinor; that gated pack was not requested. No public logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
